response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with relevant exposure to AI-agent workflows and cloud technologies. While his AI-specific experience is not as extensive as the ideal candidate, his leadership in developer tooling (e.g., MCP code generators) and production-grade system design suggests he could adapt quickly to the role's GenAI and cloud requirements.
strengths: Extensive experience (10+ years) in full-stack development and production-grade system design, including cloud platforms (AWS) and scalable architectures.
Proven leadership in developer tooling and frameworks, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) code generators, aligning with the role's focus on agentic workflows.
Strong technical mentorship and knowledge-sharing background, evidenced by workshops, talks, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Limited explicit experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures or vector databases, which are core to the role.
AI/ML experience is not deeply highlighted; most work appears to be in traditional software development or adjacent tooling.
No advanced degree (e.g., Master's/PhD) in AI or related fields, which is a preferred qualification.
